topPRs.body:
<!-- claude-slack-attribution -->
_Requested via [Slack thread](https://oplabs-pbc.slack.com/archives/C03N11M0BBN/p1794947158332169)_

## Summary

**Before:** The scheduled `check_superchain_registry` job fails on `main` ([CircleCI job 222381](https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/30302/workflows/1d53a54f-bc89-47f7-ae66-22a868cb685a/jobs/222381)). Upstream superchain-registry removed 8 sunset chains, but our pinned `lib/superchain-registry` still lists them, so the check reports `remote missing L1StandardBridgeProxy/SystemConfigProxy` for each one.

**After:** The pin points at current upstream superchain-registry `main`, and the check passes.

**How:** This bumps the `lib/superchain-registry` gitlink from `8fde8b3` to `308e08f`, which includes ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry#1416 ("chore: remove sunset chains from the registry"). The removed chains are 1135 (lisk), 185 (mint), 2702128 (xterio-eth), 4202 (lisk sepolia), 5330 (sseed), 65536 (automata), 690 (redstone) and 8008 (polynomial). No task or test under `src/` or `test/` references these chains. The same upstream commit also changes the OP Mainnet (chain 10) Proposer in `addresses.json`; that change comes along with this bump, and `check_superchain_registry` does not check it.

Verification: I ran `src/script/check-superchain-latest.sh` against `addresses.json` fetched at each SHA, with `local_file` pointed at the fetched copy. At `8fde8b3` it fails with the same 16 `remote missing` errors (exit 1). At `308e08f` it passes (exit 0). `308e08f` is upstream `main` HEAD, so its `addresses.json` is identical to what the job fetches.

## Additional context

This is the same kind of drift bump as #1605, #1508 and #1496.
